_note: OCR ground truth for REAL archive pages (spec 10.1): 30-50 pages, hand-transcribed and double-checked, split by document class and language, half calibration and half test. Same row format as fixtures/ground_truth.json so `python -m archive.cli eval-ocr` can read it. Only pages whose rights record allows this use. Replace this note with a description of the real page set; eval-ocr copies the note into its result and calibrate_gate.py refuses results whose note marks them as fixture data.

_row_fields.half: optional: 0 or 1 for the left/right half of a two-page spread
_row_fields.doc_class: printed (handwritten pages are excluded from the OCR fallback rate, spec 4.2)
_row_fields.acceptable_wer: archivist's limit for this page class (default 0.1)
_row_fields.rights_source_key: rights register entry that permits this use
